cards.question:
Forward loop over full range

Visit each element of an array from left to right.

Reverse loop over full range

Visit each element of an array from right to left.

Forward loop over half-open interval

Loop over half-open interval `[l, r)`

Forward loop over closed interval

Loop over closed interval `[l, r]`

Iterate adjacent pairs

Visit every adjacent pair `(arr[i], arr[i+1])` exactly once.

Iterate windows of size `k`

Given a length `n` array `arr`, visit every contiguous length `k` window `(arr[i], ..., arr[i + k - 1])` exactly once

Skip first element safely

Visit each element of an array except the first.

Skip last element safely

Visit each element of an array except the last.

Safe midpoint calculation

Compute the midpoint of two indices `l`, `r` without integer overflow.

Array traversal from both ends

Simultaneously traverse an array from both ends towards the middle, visiting each element exactly once.

Traverse every k-th element of an array

Given an array `arr` of length `n`, traverse the array from left to right in increments of `k`

Traverse every k-th element of an array from right to left

Given an array `arr` of length `n`, traverse the array from right to left in increments of `k`

Equilibrium index

Find an index `i` where the sum of elements `arr[0, ..., i]` equals the sum of the elements `arr[i + 1, ..., n - 1]`, or report that no such index exists.
